Home / High School

High School Division

Grades 9–12

Prepared for the national exam and what comes after.

The high school track carries students through the preparatory years with subject specialisation, exam readiness, and closer guidance as college and career decisions approach.

GRADES 9–10

General Secondary

A broad course load across sciences, mathematics, languages, and social studies that keeps every pathway open.

  • Core sciences and mathematics
  • English and Afaan Oromo language study
  • Continuous assessment alongside term exams
GRADES 11–12

Preparatory Track

Subject streaming into natural or social science, with pacing built around the national examination calendar.

  • Natural science and social science streams
  • Focused revision ahead of national exams
  • Mock exams under real timing conditions
ONGOING

Beyond the Timetable

Academic clubs and inter-school competitions give high schoolers a reason to sharpen skills outside class hours.

  • Mental-mathematics and quiz competitions
  • Peer tutoring between grade levels
  • Guidance toward university placement
Bishoftu families choosing Ebenezer for the secondary years are choosing continuity — many students complete both their foundational and high-school education on the same campus, under teachers who've followed their progress for years.
